task_description: Create a Python CLI tool (ym-sync) that syncs Yandex Music favorites, downloads tracks in FLAC (lossless), converts them to ALAC (.m4a) via ffmpeg, with incremental sync support. Downloaded FLACs go in 'Downloaded' folder, exported ALACs go flat in 'Exported' folder.

verification.summary: pip install -e . succeeds, python -m ym_sync --help shows correct usage, all module imports work cleanly. No test suite (greenfield CLI tool) but code quality verified through review. Review issues fixed: atomic state writes, filename collision prevention via track ID suffix, Optional[str] for decryption_key, conversion retry for stuck downloaded state, ffmpeg stderr output on failure.
